items.note: CONFIG/HYPERPARAMETER RETUNE, routed from the confirmed autopsy failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-906a_894b_2026-08-09 (Target 2) via /implement-substrate amend priority 1, which the 2026-08-10 governance cycle used to amend substrate_queue.json's SD-035 entry (prior failure_record item built_pending_retest -> superseded by a narrower entropy_weight/MSE-balance target). NOT a supersession: 894/894a/894b stay valid evidence (fixed rule and default-weight trainable head respectively); supersedes=None. WHAT IS ALREADY CLOSED: 894a closed the PE-sigma dimension (Spearman -1.0, held fixed at 1.0); 894b closed the training-budget dimension (training_budget_helps measured False at 914 vs 1998 head updates), so this run uses a SINGLE P0-only training budget (36 episodes/cell) freeing compute for finer entropy_weight resolution. WHAT 894b FOUND: BLAAttributionHead at the module's default entropy_weight=0.02 recovered C1 fully (0/3->3/3 seeds) but left C2 flat (0/3 seeds both budgets) -- exactly the failure mode the module's own docstring (ree_core/amygdala/attribution_head.py design decision 3) predicted for entropy_weight too large relative to the MSE term ('a large value buys C1 at C2's expense'). ARMS (6x3): ARM_REMAP_OFF (drift control/C3 denominator), ARM_HEAD_FIXED (legacy proxy, within-run replication of 894/894a/894b's matched control -- unexpectedly passing voids the comparison, reported as fixed_unexpectedly_passed), ARM_EW_0p02/0p01/0p005/0p001 (BLAAttributionHead, entropy_weight swept; 0.02 is the anchor replicating 894b's own finding under this run's seeds). CRITERIA UNCHANGED from 894/894a/894b: C1 attribution_mass_excess > 0.05 AND C2 context_jaccard_gap > 0.05 on >= 2/3 green seeds, C3 partiality >= 0.5 of matched control, C4 fire fraction <= 0.25. RUN PASS requires an entropy-weight arm to pass; also reports Spearman(entropy_weight, mass_excess) [predicted positive] and Spearman(entropy_weight, jaccard_gap) [predicted negative] over the swept arms' means via the canonical degeneracy-guarded experiments/_lib/stats.spearman, independent of pass/fail, as the direct dose-response test of the docstring's claimed direction. GOV-REUSE-1: the decisive readout (C1/C2 as a function of entropy_weight) exists in NO recorded manifest -- 894/894a/894b all used entropy_weight=0.02 fixed -- so no reanalysis is possible; a run is required. Re-derive brake (2.5b): MECH-074d autopsy count against substrate_ceiling = 0 (all three prior autopsies read competence_implementation_gap/standard-family, progressively narrowing the diagnosis rather than repeating a ceiling) -- brake does not fire. Substrate-path overlap gate (2.5c): no open corrupting substrate_queue entry touches ree_core/amygdala/attribution_head.py or its call sites. Wiring probe (2.5a): bla_attr_head_entropy_weight is wired at all three required sites in ree_core/utils/config.py (dataclass default, from_dims param, from_dims assignment) and read at ree_core/agent.py:2150-2151 into BLAAttributionHeadConfig -- already exercised successfully by 894b, no doc-vs-runtime gap. MANDATORY RECORDING FIX (894b autopsy gap): every row and per-arm summary stamps the actual entropy_weight value used (894b's manifest omitted it, though it was fixed across its own arms). Smoke PASS: --dry-run exercises every code path (6 arms x 1 seed), all engagement tier-1 checks green (remap fires in fixed+trained arms, silent in control, store differentiated at window start, episode restore effective, PE varies, baseline_store_matched_across_arms true confirming the detached-input guarantee), head_n_updates 36 in every trainable arm at smoke scale (not yet past 200-step warmup at this tiny scale, as expected -- not enforced at dry-run).
